BALOCHISTAN ORDINANCE
XIV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan General Clauses Act, 1956
Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 6th September, 2002]
No Legis: 6-62/Law/80-XI, dated
6-9-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
2nd September, 2002, is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan General
Clauses (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Addition of New Section 19A in Act VI of 1956

BALOCHISTAN GENERAL CLAUSES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
BALOCHISTAN
GENERAL CLAUSES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
BALOCHISTAN ORDINANCE
XIV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan General Clauses Act, 1956
Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 6th September, 2002]
No Legis: 6-62/Law/80-XI, dated
6-9-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
2nd September, 2002, is hereby published for general information:
2. Addition of New Section 19A
in Act VI of 1956.---In the Balochistan General Clauses Act, 1956, after
section 19, the following new section shall be added:--
19A. Rules and Orders, etc. to
be published. ---All rules, orders, regulations and circulars having the
effect of law and made or issued under any enactment shall be published in the
official Gazette.
